correctness.rationale: The proof exhaustively classifies intrinsic paths by all four endpoint choices and treats same-edge direct paths separately. Exact edge-orientation counting gives exceptional probability (m+n-2)/(4mn); conditional detour is 2 min(min(S,T),1-max(S,T)), whose survival is (1-z)^2. Independence of circle coordinates gives the mixed-orientation convolution and same-orientation baseline; replacing |S-T| by min(S+T,2-S-T) yields the complete CDF. The mean and unique negative/zero parity cases are derived algebraically. Two standalone exact-rational verifiers successfully executed 266256 route/detour comparisons and 91 independent polygon integral CDF/mean comparisons. Finite checks are corroboration, not a substitute for analytic universality. Risks: weighted edges and higher products are outside scope.

Targeted database searches and examined primary source texts did not find an equivalent full arclength CDF, conditional Beta detour or sharp grid-versus-area mean sign phase. value.rationale: The full piecewise-quadratic law answers a naturally motivated probabilistic metric invariant of periodic street networks for every pair of cycle sizes, and the universal Beta detour describes precise infrastructure-constrained routing cost relative to the ambient geometry. The exact comparison to area-uniform Manhattan-torus travel exhibits a sharp parity-dependent sign transition, including the unique 3-by-3 negative and 3-by-5 equality classes. These are structurally motivated all-parameter statements, not isolated arithmetic curiosities or textbook renamings.
